decks.title: Attic Particles and Connectives
decks.description: Fifteen of the small words that hold Attic prose together: connectives, postpositive particles, the two negatives, and two common phrases.
decks.author: Sue
decks.source: Written for this repository; the example sentences are original.

decks.title: Declensions 1: The Article and the Second Declension
decks.description: Every form of the article ὁ ἡ τό, then λόγος (masculine), δῶρον (neuter) and ὁδός (feminine) in each case and number, with the article.
decks.author: Suasor
decks.source: Written for this repository: the standard Attic paradigms, as given in Smyth's Greek Grammar.

decks.title: Declensions 2: The First Declension
decks.description: The five patterns of the first declension, with the article: χώρα (long α), θάλαττα (short α), τιμή (η), and the masculines πολίτης and νεανίας.
decks.author: Suasor
decks.source: Written for this repository: the standard Attic paradigms, as given in Smyth's Greek Grammar.

decks.title: Declensions 3: The Third Declension
decks.description: Five common third-declension types, with the article: φύλαξ (consonant stem), σῶμα (neuter in -μα), πόλις (ι stem), βασιλεύς (ευ stem) and γένος (neuter in -ος).
decks.author: Suasor
decks.source: Written for this repository: the standard Attic paradigms, as given in Smyth's Greek Grammar.
